description: Local-first personal agent for Windows 11. Electron desktop app with an offline Ollama LLM (Qwen3), voice, email, calendar, browser automation, projects and long-term memory.
name: local-agent-app

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:main: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node scripts/rename-preload.cjs
scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k "vite --config vite.config.ts" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron ."
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
